purpose: Durable human review of one exact deployment-drift evidence pack before bounded review evidence may be accepted for candidate intake.
rules: A review artifact is bound to one app, repository, reviewed commit, observed deployed commit and deployment observation id.
The workspace surfaces security/auth, API/server, database/migration, dependency/build and CI/deployment paths before tests and other paths.
A reviewer may record bounded notes and findings for changed files without changing candidate, checklist or certification state.
Every record_finding action requires reviewerId and reviewedAt; the finding stores both values and the review advances lastActivityAt.
Finding action timestamps must be UTC, must not predate the deployment observation when that timestamp is available, and must not move backwards relative to prior review activity.
Every changed file must have a human finding before evidence can be accepted.
Any reviewed_blocker finding prevents ACCEPT EVIDENCE.
Acceptance requires the literal confirmation ACCEPT EVIDENCE, a reviewer id, reviewedAt timestamp and bounded summary; acceptance reviewedAt must not predate lastActivityAt.
Acceptance advances lastActivityAt and creates a separate candidate-intake-compatible evidence record with source github and kind security_diff_review.
The accepted evidence record is bound to the exact reviewed...observed commit comparison and includes the human reviewer id in its bounded summary.
Evidence acceptance does not create a pending_review candidate; candidate materialization/intake remain separate guarded actions.

Every applied review action is first appended to the review's hash-chained Human Review Event Ledger; the stored review artifact is a deterministic replay projection. Accepted review artifacts are immutable in workspace v1.3.
If an existing review projection contains activity but has no event ledger, v1.3 fails closed and requires deliberate migration rather than inventing historical events.
nonClaims: reviewed_no_issue does not prove a file is bug-free or secure.
Evidence acceptance is not checklist approval or Defence certification.
The workspace does not replace review of underlying code, tests or runtime behaviour when needed.
lastActivityAt records explicit workspace actions only; it does not claim to measure time spent reviewing outside the workspace.
The current review artifact is a convenience projection; the append-only event ledger preserves superseded finding history from v1.3 onward.
